panel.title: QC re-check
panel.awaitingHint: The request is done and has been handed back to the QC member who sent it. Agents treat it as finished; QC confirms it passes or reports it does not.
panel.reopenHint: QC reported it does not pass; waiting for the owner to approve reopening.

reopenDialog.title: Report not passing
reopenDialog.description: Your reason goes to the owner for approval. Once approved, the request reopens for the worker and the reason is posted as a comment; agents do not see it before the owner approves.

review.title: Waiting for my review
review.description: Requests you sent that are now done and waiting for you to check.
review.empty: No requests are waiting for your review.
review.reopenPending: Reported not passing, waiting for owner

errors.crew_qc_not_awaiting: This request is no longer waiting for QC (it may have been reopened). Reload to see the latest state.
errors.crew_qc_reopen_pending: A reopen request is already waiting for the owner.
errors.crew_qc_forbidden: Only the QC member who sent this request or the owner can review it.
